messages:
Maya C: Heads-up — planning the 0.15.0 roll across API, runtime, console, and SDKs today. Need owners to confirm changelogs + any client-facing changes. I plan to lock merge queues at 16:00 PT. Who's grabbing the SDK bump + changelog?
Sam K: I can take SDK (py + js). Will open PRs to bump minor versions and add changelog entries. ETA ~2h.
Liam R: Runtime change is the KV-cache behavior tweak (perf). No API contract changes from my side — will add a note in runtime/CHANGELOG.
Anna P: Console has a small model-selector UI tweak, non-breaking. I’ll prep changelog snippet and coordinate example mapping with Sam.
Maya C: Great. I’ll run the preflight smoke at 17:30 PT. @deploy-bot can you schedule a dry-run for that window?
deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2024-06-15T17:30:00Z — will post results to thread once complete.
Sam K: Opened PRs: py-sdk #5124 (0.15.0), js-sdk #215 (0.15.0). Added TODOs to update quickstart and examples.
Liam R: Pushed runtime RC image: ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:0.15.0-rc1 — will keep tags stable until final.
Anna P: Console PR ready (WIP) — needs a quick code + UX pass. Pinging @Tara for UX review.
Tara (oncall): I can do a quick UX sweep in ~30m. Reminder: branch-protection requires a changelog label before merge.
Maya C: After the freeze I’ll publish a short changelog digest to #release-notes. Any required backports?
Sam K: One small py fix to backport to 0.14 — I’ll include backport instructions in the PR description.
Liam R: If anything blocks runtime, fallback plan is to continue serving on 0.14 images per runbook.
Maya C: Locking merge queues in 20m to stabilize head. Command I’ll run:
```bash
cictl merge-queue lock --reason \"release-cut\" --until 2024-06-15T20:00:00Z
```
deploy-bot: Merge queue locked by Maya C (reason: release-cut) — lock expires 2024-06-15T20:00:00Z.
Anna P: :thumbsup:
Sam K: Will add changelog entries to each PR, tagging @Maya for the digest.
Tara (oncall): Noted — will prioritize console review. If I see blocking UX issues I’ll flag immediately.
Maya C: Thanks all — small cadence today, but ping here if anything slips. I’ll post smoke results once dry-run completes.
